caseNameFull: F. E. Wear v. Virgil W. Johnston
attorneys: Mr. Samuel Feller, with' whom Mr. H. M. Lang-worthy was on the briefs, for plaintiffs in error. Mr. Douglas Hudson appeared for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6.
